name.zh: Atlas 800T A3 服务器集群（8 NPU / 台，跨机 RoCE）
name.en: Atlas 800T A3 server cluster (8 NPUs per server, RoCE between servers)

name.zh: 每 NPU 2 × 200G、64 口交换机、无收敛折叠 Clos（HAC-D 模板默认，主算例）
name.en: 2 × 200G per NPU, 64-port switches, non-blocking folded Clos (HAC-D template default, main case)

basis.zh: 论文：每 die 1 个 RDMA 口、每 NPU 400 Gb/s；端口数 64 与无收敛为假设；与另一份《950 与 910C》报告相同
basis.en: paper: one RDMA port per die, 400 Gb/s per NPU; radix 64 and non-blocking assumed; the same as in the other “950 and 910C” report

basis.zh: 现行 51.2T 交换芯片按 200G 口使用（假设）
basis.en: a current 51.2T switch chip used with 200G ports (assumed)

basis.zh: 第三方 800I A3 规格：每台 8 × 400GE；FiberMall 转述 SemiAnalysis：每 CM384 scale-out 1,536 只模块 = 384 网卡 + 768 叶 + 384 脊
basis.en: third-party 800I A3 listing: 8 × 400GE per server; FiberMall relaying SemiAnalysis: 1,536 scale-out modules per CM384 = 384 NIC + 768 leaf + 384 spine

name.zh: 主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛
name.en: main case with 2:1 at the leaves

superpod.source: Huawei Atlas 800T A3 product page: 10U, 8 × Ascend 910, 4 × Kunpeng 920, 784 GB/s interconnect at 1:1 — the CloudMatrix384 node used stand-alone

domainNpus.source: by definition of this option (stand-alone Atlas 800T A3 servers, RoCE between them): the UB domain is one server’s 8 NPUs on its 7 on-board L1 UB chips (node internals: arXiv 2506.12708 v3 §3.3.2; server: Huawei Atlas 800T A3 product page)
domainNpus.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was vendor; the vendor states up to 384 cards per supernode, the single-server UB domain is the design choice of this record

superpod.computeRacks.source: 4 servers (32 NPUs) per cabinet, as in the CM384 compute cabinet (air-cooled power density not public)

superpod.commRacks.source: no L2 tier, no UB optics, no communication cabinets

superpod.linksPerL1.source: the 7 on-board L1 UB chips remain the server’s internal UB fabric; their uplink ports stay unused

scaleOut.portsPerNpu.source: as the CM384 RDMA plane (2 × 200G per NPU = 400 Gb/s; a third-party 800I A3 listing shows 8 × 400GE per server, the same bandwidth)

scaleOut.radix.source: 64-port switches, non-blocking folded Clos (radix not public)

assumed.zh: 每柜 4 台服务器（32 NPU），同 CM384 计算柜（4 × 10U；风冷功率密度未公开）
assumed.en: 4 servers (32 NPUs) per cabinet, as the CM384 compute cabinet (4 × 10U; air-cooled power density not public)

assumed.zh: 板上 7 片 L1 UB 芯片保留为服务器内 UB 网络，上联口不用；无 L2、无 UB 光、无通信柜
assumed.en: the 7 on-board L1 UB chips stay as the in-server UB fabric, their uplink ports unused; no L2 tier, no UB optics, no communication cabinets

assumed.zh: scale-out 口同 CM384 RDMA 平面（每 NPU 2 × 200G = 400 Gb/s；第三方 800I A3 规格为每台 8 × 400GE，带宽相同）接 64 口无收敛折叠 Clos（radix 未公开）
assumed.en: scale-out ports as the CM384 RDMA plane (2 × 200G per NPU = 400 Gb/s; a third-party 800I A3 listing shows 8 × 400GE per server, the same bandwidth) into a non-blocking 64-port folded Clos (radix not public)

ubLabel.zh: 服务器内 UB（7 片 L1 芯片），无光链路
ubLabel.en: in-server UB (7 L1 chips), no optics

podLabel.zh: UB 域 = 一台 800T A3 服务器
